samples.summary: design-sandbox API-key fixture not updated for the new `createdBy` field — the owner-only "Created by" column renders "Unknown" in the visual lane

The PR's workspace-settings page now renders `creatorName(apiKey.createdBy)` for owners (packages/frontend/src/app/workspaces/workspace-settings.tsx:475), and `creatorName` falls back to "Unknown" when no member matches (workspace-settings.tsx:153-155). The fixture is untyped JSON, so no tsc lane catches it. Fix: add `createdBy: FIXTURE_USER.id` (and ideally a second key created by member id 2) to the fixture.
